src.label: Embassy of Sri Lanka in Paris — importing pet animals to Sri Lanka (relaying Department of Animal Production and Health rules)

head: An import permit comes first, and dogs and cats face 30 days of quarantine at your own premises.
lines: The embassy page says an import permit can be obtained from the Director General of the Department of Animal Production and Health. It must be obtained at least two weeks before export and is valid for 90 days from the date of issue.

Imported dogs and cats are inspected for quarantine at Katunayake airport, with samples taken for testing if necessary. They then serve a 30-day post-import quarantine at the owner's premises: the importer signs a Quarantine Surveillance Agreement with the Animal Quarantine Officer at the airport and gives the full address and phone number where the animal will be kept.
The page says you may have to pay duty on the pet and that a pet arriving as cargo may need a TIN number to clear. It cites a notification dated 2006, so confirm the details with the department.
